## Summary / 摘要

<!-- What does this PR change and why? 这个 PR 改了什么、为什么改？ -->

## Type / 类型

- [ ] `feat:` new feature
- [ ] `fix:` bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` documentation
- [ ] `chore:` maintenance / dependencies
- [ ] `ci:` workflow changes

## Checklist / 自检

- [ ] `pytest tests/` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check` / `ruff format --check` / `mypy` are clean
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies under `src/` (stdlib only / 核心层零依赖)
- [ ] `docs/` updated when user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Version + `CITATION.cff` bumped only in release PRs
